results.explanation: The Hydrogen Corridors Coalition builds bankable hydrogen and ammonia export corridors from North Africa to European ports, matching your interest in green hydrogen export corridors in North Africa.

Fatima Zahra Benali, Directrice générale at Sahara Solar Holdings in Morocco, advises on hydrogen export corridors and ammonia transport. You already know each other through Anders Lindqvist's co-membership of the Hydrogen Corridors Coalition.

Hamza Rachidi, Ingénieur en chef for electrolysers at Sahara Solar Holdings in Morocco, works on hydrogen export corridors and ammonia transport. You already know each other through the Hydrogen Corridors Coalition.

Dr. Samuel Mwangi, Secretary General of the East Africa Power Pool Secretariat, has advised on hydrogen export corridors and ammonia shipping. You already know each other through the Hydrogen Corridors Coalition.
Sahara Solar Holdings in Morocco is building a 400 MW electrolysis project seeking offtakers, and is active in the Hydrogen Corridors Coalition, which matches your North Africa focus.
Omar Al-Mansoori, Managing Director of Energy Investments at Gulf Sovereign Capital in the UAE, leads the fund's hydrogen and battery-mineral stakes and works on green hydrogen offtake agreements.
Ahmed Khalil, Director of Energy Transition at Gulf Sovereign Capital, advises on hydrogen export corridors and sources MENA hydrogen and ammonia projects for the fund's transition portfolio.

Laila Al-Suwaidi, CEO of Gulf Sovereign Capital in the UAE, sets the fund's overall investment strategy, which covers green hydrogen offtake and electrolyser deployment. Introductions go through the Managing Director.

Prof. Klaus Weber, Director of the European Climate Finance Institute, has led green bond and transition-finance programmes for emerging markets. He also attended the public Ocean finance breakfast on blue bonds and guarantees.

Julia Schmidt, Senior Economist at the European Climate Finance Institute, has led green bond and transition-finance programmes for emerging markets. She also works on resilient trade routes, logistics and nearshoring strategies.

Dr. Samuel Mwangi, Secretary General of the East Africa Power Pool Secretariat, structures blended-finance vehicles that crowd private capital into transition projects. He is also named in the Hydrogen Corridors Coalition Annual Report 2026.

Victoria Hale, Chair & CEO of Atlas Logistics, structures blended-finance vehicles that crowd private capital into transition projects. She is also named in the Hydrogen Corridors Coalition Annual Report 2026 in connection with port infrastructure.

Isabel Fernández, President of Banco Solidario de las Américas, expands microfinance and digital credit for small producers, a direct fit. You already know each other from the June 2026 roundtable on digital credit for smallholders.

Tomás Herrera, Director of Digital Finance at Banco Solidario de las Américas, works on digital credit for small producers and fraud controls. You already know each other from the June 2026 roundtable on digital credit for smallholders.

Shares these words with the request: smallholder, farmers; related words: agriculture, agritech, food, pequenos, productores, credito; same theme: food-security, financial-inclusion. You already have a direct relationship.

María José Quispe, founder and CEO of Andes AgriTech, scales agritech for smallholder yields, a relevant link to farm-level credit. Rafael Ortega Ruiz, a colleague at the same firm, can introduce you.

Zanele Dube, Programme Director for Africa at the Global Vaccine Access Fund, designs credit products for underserved small businesses, a partial fit for a Latin American farmer credit programme. Thabo Nkosi has worked with Zanele Dube and can introduce you.

Hiroshi Tanaka, Chief Scientist at Singapore Digital Trust Lab, works on AI governance and cybersecurity, including model risk oversight and incident-response cooperation. Tanaka is also a participant in the Responsible AI Charter.
Mikko Tamm, Director at CyberShield Alliance, focuses on cyber resilience and contributes to AI policy dialogues. Tamm is a participant in the Responsible AI Charter and the Cyber Resilience Pact.

Dr. Nadia Petrova, Head of AI Policy at CyberShield Alliance, contributes to AI policy and regulation dialogues. Petrova is a participant in the Responsible AI Charter, a voluntary AI risk management charter.

Dr. Chen Wei, Professor of Computational Policy at Singapore Digital Trust Lab, contributes to AI policy and regulation dialogues. Wei attended the AI governance roundtable in Singapore; the cybersecurity side is not documented in the record.

Arjun Mehta, CTO at FutureSkills Foundation, works on AI governance and cybersecurity, including responsible AI frameworks and incident-response cooperation. Mehta is also active in skills programmes for the green transition.
Nguyen Thi Lan, Executive Director at Mekong Water Partnership, works on water scarcity, irrigation efficiency and river-basin management in Asia-Pacific, and takes part in the Water-Food Nexus Lab.
Dr. Ong Mei Ling, Director of Basin Finance at Mekong Water Partnership, works on water scarcity and basin-level financing in Asia-Pacific and is a participant in the Water-Food Nexus Lab.
The Water-Food Nexus Lab pilots joint water and agriculture interventions in the Mekong, a clear match for water scarcity and food systems work in Asia.
Pedro Alves, Head of Agronomy at Andes AgriTech, works on food security and water management and takes part in the Water-Food Nexus Lab, though his work is centred in the Americas.
María José Quispe, Founder and CEO of Andes AgriTech, scales agritech for yields and works on efficient irrigation, and takes part in the Water-Food Nexus Lab that operates in the Mekong.

Project Tidewater is a co-investment platform for African battery-mineral processing, a direct fit for a critical-minerals miner. Its membership is still being formed, and it is named in the draft investment memo Project Tidewater (D-02).

The Resilient Supply Chains Dialogue brings together shippers, producers and trade officials on supply-chain risk in Africa and Europe, relevant to critical-minerals supply chains. It meets quarterly.

The Hydrogen Corridors Coalition builds hydrogen and ammonia export corridors across Africa, Asia-Pacific, Europe and MENA, with working groups on offtake standards and port infrastructure. Its 2026 annual report names it (D-01); this fits a miner looking at supply-chain logistics, though the focus is green hydrogen.

Ana Costa, Ocean Finance Lead at Northstar Impact Partners, works on marine conservation finance and blue bonds. Costa took part in the Blue Economy Accelerator, which prepares blue-bond pipelines for island states.

Ingrid Solberg, Ocean Programme Lead at Pacific Ocean Trust, works on marine conservation finance and blue bonds. Solberg is a participant in the Blue Economy Accelerator and attended the public Ocean finance breakfast.

Kalesi Naivalu, Director at Pacific Ocean Trust, structures blended-finance vehicles for transition projects. Naivalu participates in the Blue Economy Accelerator's blue-bond pipelines for island states.
Nguyen Thi Lan, Executive Director at Mekong Water Partnership, works on blue bonds and marine conservation finance. Lan's main focus is water and agriculture, so the ocean finance link is secondary.
The Blue Economy Accelerator prepares blue-bond pipelines for Pacific and Atlantic island states. Its participants include Kalesi Naivalu, Ingrid Solberg and Ana Costa, who all work on ocean finance.
The Responsible AI Charter is a voluntary AI risk management charter signed by 40 member organisations, with annual implementation reviews. It matches the request for work on responsible AI.

Mikko Tamm, Director at CyberShield Alliance in Estonia, works on AI policy and regulation dialogues and is linked to the Responsible AI Charter. This fits the request for who leads responsible AI work.
